content: Cigar Register is a standalone desktop application specifically designed for Windows users who are cigar enthusiasts and collectors. It allows users to access detailed information about cigars, manage their humidors and cigar collections, track their shopping history, create a wishlist, and document their smoking experiences along with personal reviews. The software is available for free download from its official website. The software includes a comprehensive cigar database that contains detailed information on over 3,800 cigars, including specifics about tobacco leaves, series, and brands. This database can be used as a learning tool for those new to cigars or as a reliable reference for seasoned collectors. Users can utilize the My Cigars feature to add their humidors and build a digital inventory of their current cigar collection using the database. This feature also allows users to monitor their shopping history, track the conditions of their humidors by recording temperature and humidity levels, and create a wishlist of their favorite cigars. The Smokeroom feature enables users to document their smoking experiences in detail, including personal ratings and reviews of the cigars they smoke. These records can be organized and revisited later using filters such as a calendar view. These elements make it easy for users to quickly learn and enjoy the software’s capabilities.
